expected_findings.description: Today's unused-flag rule fires after 14 days without calls, but the flag list's Stale tag and the stale flag health check wait 30 days (STALE_FLAG_THRESHOLD_DAYS), so a flag called 20 days ago shows in the cleanup item while the flag page does not mark it stale. Reuse the stale definition via the facade.

The remote-configuration and survey/tour key filter runs after list_flags_created_by applies its 500-flag limit, so excluded flags use up slots first. Exclude them in the facade query before the slice, which also drops remote_configuration from CreatedFlag.

covers_all_environments guards a case production does not have (every project has exactly one team), so the facade field, its query per summary, the branch in find and three tests exist for an always-true condition.

The new flag call reader picks its table via get_flag_evaluations_read_mode but is not added to the READ_FLAG_EVALUATIONS comment in facade/enums.py that lists the readers, so a later change to the read mode will not account for it.
